sections.h2: Handyman work in Ruskin and Sun City Center
paras: Ruskin and Sun City Center are neighboring South Shore communities south of [Apollo Beach](/locations/apollo-beach). Ruskin is a waterfront area on Tampa Bay with older homes and newer subdivisions. Sun City Center is a large 55+ community.

Residents often ask for [grab bars](/services/grab-bar-installation) and safety updates, and for [lanai and screen room](/services/lanai-screen-repair) panel repairs. Our crew also swaps fixtures, repairs doors and hardware, removes popcorn ceilings after an asbestos test, and handles HOA-ready exterior touch-ups.
